name: Workbench
duplicates: Old UI (Figma 首页 › 工作台) has default and expanded task lists. Both are now shown in the Workbench prototype. Select language, Log out and the operation-result screen remain outside this study.
flow: tap the section name in the header
tap a task card that has no detail page (Pregnancy check)
tap Toolbox in the bottom bar

notes.purpose: The first screen of the app: what needs doing now in the worker's section, task by task across all its units.

elements.name: Task card · state
elements.shows: Farrowing: "2 sows farrowing · 4 due today"; Piglet processing: "Next care · Tomorrow"

states.when: f.alert.count > 0 (a confirmed exception). No sample reaches it: Home never supplies alert
states.shows: Exception count and its label, rank 0

states.when: Farrowing only: at least one sow row in the scope is flagged active
states.shows: "N sows farrowing"; supporting line "N due today" when due > 0 (the "N past expected date" line needs a late count, which no sample supplies)

states.when: Farrowing, no live sow, late > 0. No sample reaches it: Home never supplies late
states.shows: "N sows past expected date"; do not infer a final outcome from missing records

states.when: Not farrowing and the due count in the scope is > 0
states.shows: One task-specific headline and at most one supporting fact. Heat Overview is recorded-in-heat / target; Return-heat uses the temporary historical return facts.

states.when: Due > 0 and f.overdue > 0. No sample reaches it: Home never supplies overdue
states.shows: Supporting line "N past due" replaces the other line; rank 1

states.when: f.rechecks > 0, or f.first and f.repeat supplied. No sample reaches it
states.shows: "N rechecks due" (before "scheduled later"); breeding "N first · N repeat"

states.when: The open task has a separately confirmed upstream dependency
states.shows: "Waiting for <task> to close", quiet style

states.when: f.unitComplete is set. No sample reaches it
states.shows: "Unit work complete · task still open"

states.when: An authoritative in-progress task has later or unknown next work
states.shows: A quiet next-time or in-progress line; the card stays in Today’s work.

states.when: Nothing due and no nextLabel. No sample reaches it: every sample card has a nextAt
states.shows: "Waiting for heat confirmations" (breeding), "Waiting for next scheduled care" (piglet), "Waiting for farrowing records" (postpartum), else "No work due now"

states.when: Authoritative completion or early end happened today in farm time
states.shows: Compact receipt at the bottom (see Closed task card)

elements.logic: Authoritative task status selects the list. Card content resolves confirmed exception, task-specific facts, unit status, then next scheduled action. A full bar never changes task status.
elements.rule: Show one task instance per card; Home figures may be outcomes or currently eligible objects depending on task type.

elements.name: Task card · headline and supporting line
elements.shows: 2 sows farrowing · 4 due today
elements.logic: One main task-specific fact and at most one supporting line. Farrowing uses recorded activity before expected dates. Heat Overview uses recorded-in-heat / target; Breeding Overview uses mated-at-least-once / heat-marked; Return-heat temporarily uses historical return facts.

elements.name: Task card · progress bar
elements.shows: Farrowed · 7 / 18 sows
elements.logic: Each bar names its numerator and denominator. Farrowing uses current task sows; death or abortion leaves that denominator. Heat Overview shows an outcome bar, Breeding Overview shows at-least-once coverage, and Return-heat has no Home bar.

elements.name: Task card · timing pill and footer
elements.shows: Day 2 of 7 · Across 3 units · View task
elements.logic: The pill is the position in the batch window (cardFields day, days), "Today" when the window is one day; it is context, not a completion measure, and not the litters' own age. "Across N units" = units that carry the task (not units with work due); in a unit scope the footer is replaced by an arrow in the header and the card opens that unit's task.

elements.name: "Next" sub-heading and card order
elements.shows: Next
elements.logic: Today’s work sorts confirmed actionable exceptions, explicit overdue work, today’s scheduled actions, previously scheduled unstarted tasks, assigned executable undated tasks, then other in-progress tasks. Ties use time and stable task ID; task types do not add a grouping layer.

elements.name: Task-list limit
elements.shows: First five task-instance cards · See all N tasks
elements.logic: Expansion uses the complete scoped total and preserves order. If hidden cards contain confirmed exceptions or overdue tasks, show their separate counts. Scope change or leaving Home resets expansion.

elements.name: App-shell Saved work status
elements.shows: ↑ 3 in a compact app-header badge

states.when: Records are queued and there is no connection
states.shows: The app-header badge shows the phone-wide count. Home has no separate saved-work card.

states.when: A connection becomes available
states.shows: Records upload automatically; there is no Upload button.

states.when: A record failed or conflicts
states.shows: The badge says Fix N and opens the Data sync flow.

states.when: Automatic upload is running
states.shows: The badge shows Sending N.

states.when: Nothing is waiting
states.shows: The badge disappears; Data sync still shows the empty state.

elements.logic: The app-shell entry appears on Home and internal pages. It counts all unsent records on this phone regardless of section, unit or task. The queue is fictional in this prototype; the Data sync feature owns record-level outcomes.

elements.name: Section and unit scope
elements.shows: Farrowing ⌄ · Overview · Choose unit · 3 units
elements.logic: Section on first load = URL `section` when valid, else the last one picked (localStorage sentri-home-prototype-section; ignored if storage is blocked), else Gestation. The second scope button reads "Choose unit" with no unit chosen and "Unit N" with one; the small figure is the number of units in the section (Farrowing 6, 7, 8; Gestation 7, 8, 9; Breeding 1-4; Nursery 12, 13). Choosing a unit re-runs every card rule on that unit's figures; whole-task closure stays global.

elements.name: Closed task card
elements.shows: Piglet processing · Batch 26 · Across 3 units · Completed · Today, 09:10

states.when: completedAt is set on the instance
states.shows: Check icon, title, batch (and scope in the Overview), "Completed · <stamp>"

states.when: terminatedAt is set (End task early)
states.shows: Stop icon and "Ended early · <stamp>"

elements.logic: Closed cards collect at the bottom under "Closed tasks N" (N = closed instances in the scope), always sort last, and never show due counts again, even if old records would say otherwise.

copy: (raw) every string on Home is literal in home-astra-prototype.js and astra-home-task-card.js; none uses ux/laws/strings.json yet
edge: A section with no tasks shows the quiet empty state (Nursery, see workbench.quiet-section).
A unit that does not carry a task hides that task's card.
issues: The visible date "Sample · Thu, 8 Jul" is a fixed fixture, not the device clock or a real task schedule. The connected Home date source remains open.
"Across 3 units" counts units that carry the task, not units with work due, and repeats on every card.
The Piglet card mixes litters ("4 litters with care due") and pens ("1 / 8 pens"). A pen is a litter in the prototype.

The Piglet card is an independent Batch 27 / 8-pen fixture; the linked piglet-processing page is a Batch 40 / 12-pen fixture. The click-through shows a destination, not the same task instance. Align fixtures before connected-data acceptance.

Assistant, Scan and Toolbox are visible prototype entrances to separate sample pages. A Home-only native preview explains that they are not connected; production navigation belongs to their owning features.
The app-header Saved work badge counts fictional records across the phone; it opens the separate Data sync prototype without taking a Home card row.
`layout=focus` has no effect on Home; it is only forwarded to detail pages.
No way to reach language or log out (the old Figma has both).

elements.name: Pregnancy check card
elements.shows: 5 sows ready to check · 7 scheduled later · 8 / 20 sows

states.when: Check windows are open
states.shows: "N sows ready to check" = sum of due {7:2, 8:2, 9:1}; supporting line "N scheduled later" (unrecorded 12 minus due 5)

states.when: Nothing due, next check known (Batch 32)
states.shows: "Next checks · Tomorrow", 0 / 8 sows

elements.logic: Supporting line priority: overdue checks, then due rechecks, then scheduled later; only the first applies and rechecks are inside the main count. A full first-check bar does not complete later checks.

elements.name: Return-heat card
elements.shows: 1 sow recorded returned · 9 without return record
elements.rule: Only explicit activity marks a round complete. No return and a blank mark are not evidence of a completed or negative observation. No Home progress bar, return rate or elapsed-time bar.
elements.logic: Temporary Home bridge: historical returns and no-return-record count share one population. Unit estimated-date and submitted-signs figures may overlap. No pie or progress bar.

elements.name: "Next" sub-heading and card order
elements.shows: Next
elements.logic: Cards sort by attention rank: live farrowing or alert 0, overdue 1, due 2, waiting 3 (earliest next event first), closed 4. Equal ranks keep their order so the list does not jump. "Next" is printed once above the first quiet card (waiting, round complete or upcoming).
